plugin.name: DSH Settings Hub
plugin.summary: A safe searchable directory with configurable built-in line icons for DSH settings pages.

targetUsers: DSH Web users with many settings and plugin pages
problem: DSH settings become difficult to scan after many plugins add pages, while DOM reordering can break official navigation and upgrades.
whyNow: DSH 0.1.1-rc.1 and rc.2 expose public settings slot ledgers that allow a safer additive directory.
trigger: The user opens the Settings Hub section and searches or selects an entry.

outcome.expectedResult: Users can search, group, favorite, assign built-in line icons, and open registered settings pages without changing the official navigation structure.
acceptanceCriteria: The hub lists fixture settings and plugin tabs from public slot metadata.
Each listed entry receives an automatic built-in line icon and accepts a validated per-entry icon choice.
Opening an item activates only an existing official control after a user click.
Malformed, unknown, or oversized preference state fails closed.
Disposable rc.1 and rc.2 Web Profiles install, compose, start, and uninstall successfully.
nonGoals: Use network, commands, credentials, devices, model Tools, or restarts

capabilities: Render and configure dependency-free built-in line SVG icons
Activate an existing official settings control

read: settings.section and settings.plugins.tab public slot metadata
write: bounded browser localStorage favorite IDs and built-in icon assignments

ui.notes: Additive page with plugin-owned icons; official navigation remains unchanged because rc.1/rc.2 has no public icon seam.

privacy: No settings values or Profile files are read

notes: Clean-room implementation derived from the user outcome and official DSH rc.1/rc.2 seams; no third-party source copied.
